--- a/tests/unit/acl.tcl
+++ b/tests/unit/acl.tcl
@@ -1084,6 +1084,32 @@
         $rd2 close
     }
 
+    start_server [list overrides [list aclfile [file normalize "$server_path/user.acl"]] tags {repl}] {
+        test {ACL LOAD on a replica preserves replication} {
+            set primary [srv -1 client]
+            set replica [srv 0 client]
+
+            $replica replicaof [srv -1 host] [srv -1 port]
+            wait_for_sync $replica
+
+            $replica ACL DELUSER bob
+            assert_equal {} [$replica ACL GETUSER bob]
+            assert_equal OK [$replica ACL LOAD]
+            assert_equal [$primary ACL GETUSER bob] [$replica ACL GETUSER bob]
+
+            # Replication must still bypass the local user's permissions.
+            $replica ACL SETUSER default -set
+            assert_error {NOPERM*} {$replica SET acl-reload-test value}
+            $primary SET acl-reload-test value
+            wait_for_ofs_sync $primary $replica
+            assert_equal value [$replica GET acl-reload-test]
+            assert_equal up [status $replica master_link_status]
+        }
+    }
+
     test {ACL load and save} {
         r ACL setuser eve +get allkeys >eve on
         r ACL save
PATCH
